summary: Innate Pharma furnished a Form 6-K confirming its previously announced strategic partnership with Sobi became effective after antitrust waiting periods expired and other closing conditions were met. Closing triggers a USD 75 million upfront payment to Innate and initiates the TELLOMAK-3 confirmatory Phase 3 study of lacutamab in cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, with first patient expected in Q1 2027. Sobi receives exclusive global commercialization rights upon potential accelerated approval and may assume full global development rights after positive Phase 3 results. This is an ordinary licensing-collaboration effectiveness notice, not a special situation; watch trial enrollment and approval timelines.
